name: North & Central Steppe (Astana · Karaganda · Kostanay · Pavlodar)

language.script_notes: Russian is especially dominant in the north, where a large ethnic Russian population lives, so signs are frequently bilingual and Russian may appear alone; the extra Kazakh letters appear on official signs.

architecture.roof_style: Metal roofs on village houses; flat roofs on Soviet blocks; a spiky modern skyline in the capital.
architecture.wall_construction: Soviet panel blocks and single-storey houses in the mining and industrial towns of the center (Karaganda); a planned capital of futuristic towers, gold-glass buildings and wide avenues built on a bare steppe.
architecture.wall_color_palette: Grey concrete and glass, with gold and white on the capital's landmarks.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: The capital's tower, pyramid and tent-shaped landmarks; Soviet mining towns and monuments; Russian-style wooden houses in the north.

nature.vegetation: Endless grass steppe, with birch groves and pine forest in the northern lake-dotted areas and dry feather-grass steppe toward the center.
nature.terrain: Extremely flat, open steppe with low hills in the Kazakh Uplands; lakes and wetlands such as Korgalzhyn in the north; very low population density.
nature.climate_signature: Bitterly cold winters — the capital is among the coldest capitals on Earth — and hot dry summers, with huge skies.

vehicles.plate_format: Region codes such as 01 (Astana) and 09 (Karaganda) in the square on the right.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: Coverage centers on the capital, Karaganda and the main highways; between the towns it is very sparse.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Flat steppe and birch forest, Soviet blocks, Cyrillic and Russian signage
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The letters ә, ғ, қ, ң, ө, ұ, ү and һ and plates with a light-blue flag and 'KZ' set it apart from Russian signs and plates.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same plates and script
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The north and center is flat cold steppe and birch groves; the southeast has snowy mountains and the west has dry Caspian desert.
